data.title: Mon3tr · 冷曜结晶的傲岸低伏

data.description: 罗德岛医疗下层隔离观测室，绿光监视器有节奏地闪烁着平稳波形。优雅伏在金属长椅上，墨绿结晶在白皙脊背两侧若隐若现，冷傲红眸睨视博士，尖锐而充满危险魔性。 她微微抬眸轻语——“……嘶。别把我和那些软弱的干员相提并论，博士。但若你敢靠得更近，我倒不介意试探你的底线。”
data.promptProse: Mon3tr crouches with predatory stillness atop a stainless metal bench inside a sub-level medical observation room at midnight, wearing a structured obsidian-leather and emerald micro-mesh cutout bralette with an open back and matching briefs. Looking back with cool green eyes, she is rimmed by pulsing green monitor waveforms across the darkened floor.
data.animaCaption: Crouching with feline poise atop a cold metal bench in an open-backed obsidian leather and green mesh cutout lingerie set, she glances back with sharp, aloof eyes. Pulsing green monitor displays cast crisp geometric light across the dark isolation lab.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a structured obsidian leather-and-emerald micro-mesh cutout bralette with an open back clearing her spine crystals, paired with matching black briefs.
